reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 3
       THEN ROUND(AVG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
  END AS avg_price_3v
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
  ROUND((list_price_eur
    + LAG(list_price_eur, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from)
    + LAG(list_price_eur, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from)) / 3, 2) AS avg_price_3v
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25

WITH w AS (
  -- one row per product per price version
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    AVG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_3,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM price_history
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur, CASE WHEN n = 3 THEN ROUND(avg_3, 2) END AS avg_price_3v
FROM w

other_way.tradeoff: Adding the price and the two before it with LAG leaves short windows missing by itself, but it needs one more LAG for every extra version.

solver.query:
SELECT product_id, CAST(valid_from AS DATE) AS valid_from, list_price_eur,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER w = 3 THEN ROUND(AVG(list_price_eur) OVER w, 2) END AS avg_price_3v
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY CAST(valid_from AS DATE) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
